answer: Stamp every action with a Lamport logical clock so the causal order of an identity's life is public and checkable: each action must carry a clock value greater than the one before it. A wharf is built piling by piling, and a mirror cannot reflect a face that has not yet arrived. A ripple spreads outward from where the stone fell, never backward, and a batch of fakes sharing one script will show identical clock patterns, while genuine agents each trace their own irregular, causal path through time.
